thinkingSteps.title: Brute force idea
thinkingSteps.body: For Reconstruct Itinerary, first describe a slow but correct approach (often nested loops or rescanning).

thinkingSteps.title: Why it is slow
thinkingSteps.body: Count the loops. If work looks like n×n, say so. Google interviewers want that honesty.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: The problem can be approached using a depth-first search (DFS) approach. We start from the "JFK" airport and explore all possible routes by visiting each airport exactly once. We use a dictionary to store the destinations for each source airport, and for each source airport, we sort the destinations in lexicographical order. This ensures that we visit the airports in the desired order.
